 MCX Q2 Results: Profit rockets 130% YoY to Rs 455 crore, revenue jumps 114%
 SECTIONS MCX Q2 Results: Profit rockets 130% YoY to Rs 455 crore, revenue jumps 114% By Kumar Gaurav , ETMarkets.com Last Updated: Nov 03, 2026, 10:13:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Multi Commodity Exchange of India reported a 130% year-on-year jump in Q2FY26 consolidated net profit to Rs 454.57 crore, while revenue surged 114%. EBITDA rose 151%, margins expanded and shares touched a fresh 52-week high.

 Agencies MCX delivers stellar quarterly earnings with triple-digit profit growth, doubled revenue, expanding EBITDA margins and strong stock market performance in 2026.
 Multi Commodity Exchange of India (MCX) on Tuesday reported a 130% year-on-year (YoY) surge in consolidated net profit to Rs 454.57 crore in the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 197.47 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year.
 The exchange's revenue from operations surged 114% YoY to Rs 799.66 crore from Rs 374.23 crore in the year-ago quarter, according to its regulatory filing.
On the expenses front, total expenses rose 40.5% YoY to Rs 211.36 crore during the quarter under review, compared with Rs 150.41 crore reported in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) jumped 151% YoY to Rs 611.24 crore, compared with Rs 243.63 crore in the year-ago period. EBITDA margin also expanded to 76.4% from 65.1% a year earlier.
On a standalone basis, net profit after tax (PAT) jumped 159% YoY to Rs 405.35 crore in Q2FY26, compared with Rs 156.43 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. Revenue from operations rose 118% YoY to Rs 765.61 crore in the quarter under review, from Rs 351.61 crore in the year-ago period.

 MCX shares settled 7.81% higher at Rs 3,493 apiece on the BSE on Tuesday, against the previous close of Rs 3,240. During the session, the stock surged as much as 9.16% to hit a fresh 52-week high of Rs 3,537. The counter traded in a range of Rs 3,253-3,537 on the BSE.
 So far in 2026, MCX shares have delivered returns of around 59%, according to BSE data. At the prevailing market price, the exchange commanded a market capitalization of approximately Rs 89,068 crore on the BSE.
